496f9d8c19: The two most common problems in management games are “why should I keep playing?” and “late game is just bigger numbers”. The designs below target both.
8cb6cc35a2: Short term: each round is a level with 1–3 stars. Targets are based on burgers sold in the player's recent rounds × the current price, so upgrading the price raises the target, while upgrading heat and range makes stars easier.
dbf542e136: Mid term: the Training Center button always shows the “next goal” and a progress bar; moving shops means entering the next chapter.
179edfa1e7: Long term: launch prestige, the interstellar map and 39 achievements.
f88309a8df: Every 5th level is a challenge level with double rewards, rotating through five rule sets: golden patty bonanza, patty frenzy, flames everywhere, slippery showdown and time rush.
fb1ad8734c: In the earliest version, new tools only increased range, and testers soon got bored. Later every new tool gained a visible skill while keeping the skills of the tools before it:
d523dfd12e: Double spatula: a mirrored second spatula grills at the symmetric spot on the griddle
a4f3ee04bb: Blowtorch: the spatula leaves a flame trail that keeps cooking patties
a44508b4f4: Solar cooker: a burst of sunlight every 6 seconds cooks every patty 40% at once
0839804ce7: Flip: a quick swipe between 30% and 80% cooked flips the patty for extra money
90bbb57ae4: Flames: telegraphed before they appear; touching one stops your heat for 1.2 s, but they also help cook
cc1aaa4589: Items: extra time, magnet, double price, chili stir-fry; you have to move over to grab them
fbe8793c39: Slippery patties: dodge the spatula, and are worth more when caught
6a0ff71b3f: Cat: steals any patty left uncooked for 6 s; touch the cat to scare it away
e7998d9613: Fever Time: a full combo doubles price and serving speed
df36fc8541: Grand opening: ×3 income for the first 3 rounds, so the first upgrade is affordable almost immediately
e00b79735d: Guaranteed golden patty in round 4: an early surprise
2a3169f1d2: A one-line tip the first time a mechanic appears, instead of a long tutorial
105697c1be: Rewarded ads only: watch an ad for extra time, double income or a free upgrade; no in-app purchases
285d0f00dd: 8 tracked key events: end of business, shop move, launch, achievements and more, to find where players drop off after release
357a642290: Friends playtested on iPhone, and every round of feedback led to a revision. Listed in chronological order below.
01c0fad3a2: The game area was too small on screen, with too much empty space at the top
9b51920ffd: UILay out the top bar from the position of Douyin's capsule button in the top right; the griddle height adapts between 720 and 880 to the screen
e662116614: The interstellar home background showed only a small patch in the bottom-left corner on iPhone
a00ab9617b: TechiOS WebGL requires power-of-two sizes for tiled textures, so the texture became 128 px
a478bd763d: The numbers were too big and tiring to read
62fe7309e7: BalanceRaised all prices and multipliers to the power of 0.7, then retuned to the original pacing with the simulator; numbers now display as 10K / 100M units; old saves convert automatically on load
40b429e7f4: It got boring after a while; tools only changed in range
6babd64d70: GameplayTool skills, plus flipping, flames, items, slippery patties and Fever Time
bf247f4f2a: The opening was not engaging enough, yet overall progress felt a bit fast
871ce24c0a: BalanceGrand opening and the round-4 golden patty speed up the start, while mid- and late-game prices go up across the board
f5504957df: Goals were unclear, there were no levels, and motivation was low
a47b48ec46: SystemsLevels with 1–3 stars, challenge levels and a “next goal” progress bar on the home screen
514da9ef88: Players wanted to pause mid-round or quit early
a88a15eaca: UXA pause button; closing early keeps the money earned but does not clear the level; the game auto-pauses in the background
810ee150fc: The home screen was cluttered and the skill tree was hard to read
4bd72ab093: UIReordered the home screen as “open for business → Training Center → achievements”; turned the skill tree into a list grouped by category; drew 9 new shop scenes
b8c96eec8f: The spatula at max level was huge and nearly filled the screen
1cce9d87af: BalanceIt used to multiply +10% per level, giving a max radius of about 290 (on a 450-wide griddle). Now each level adds a flat 6% and tool bonuses are smaller, for about 100 at max; the double spatula gained cooking speed to compensate, and the simulator confirmed pacing slowed by only 5 minutes
f415b4bf65: Pacing: tuned with a simulator, not by feel
7b16c79ab2: I wrote a bot player in the Unity editor that runs the game's own logic code to play automatically: it chases patties, grabs items, dodges flames and buys upgrades by value. Every price change is run through it first to check that the milestones below land within their target ranges.

1c411a15d1: Game logic and presentation are fully separated, so the same logic runs on phones and can also be driven by the simulator for automated runs.
